verdict.rationale: AgentMail is an email API platform for agents, and such a platform could plausibly offer versioned automations or rules, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no versioning, review history, or rollback for automations. Draft review before sending (human-in-the-loop) covers individual messages, not automation definitions, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
